title: Category navigation and recursive expansion make implementation artifacts inspectable in the Observatory workspace
statement: The Observatory worker reports that this project's 39 heterogeneous projected records were partly hidden by one-level expansion: implementation artifacts sat below derived areas. Producer 4d107c6 (observstory PR #26, stacked on #24) adds category filters, shared search and ancestor-preserving recursive display. It keeps provenance and leaves lifecycle as unknown. A local consumer build with that producer renders 42 records with the filters (PR #19).

author.name: Codex (Observatory worker); filed by Claude Code coordinator

conditions: Producer evidence lives in blackmath88/observstory at 4d107c6 (frontend/docs/visual-workspace/REVIEW.md); the local pin evidence lives on branch blackmath88/nuc-20261031-observatory-pin.
Worker self-verification on captured inputs plus a coordinator local build; no CI run, no deployment.
Does not establish implementation progress, owners or dates.
